description: This file defines the SourceBuilder interface, a mutable builder pattern for creating Source instances with fluent API methods, including configuration of addresses, QoS, authorization, acknowledgment, payload, and response settings.

classes.name: SourceBuilder
classes.description: A fluent interface for building Source objects with configurable parameters such as addresses, QoS, authorization, acknowledgment, header mapping, payload mapping, and reply targets.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Sets the list of addresses for the source.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Adds a single address to the source.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the index of the source inside a connection.

methods.name: qos
methods.description: Sets the Quality of Service level for the source.

methods.name: enforcement
methods.description: Sets enforcement options; may be null if enforcement is not enabled.

methods.name: acknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Configures acknowledgement requests with optional filters.

methods.name: replyTarget
methods.description: Sets the reply target for responses.

methods.name: declaredAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Specifies which acknowledgement labels are permitted.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Source instance.
